title: The entropy photon-number inequality

issues.location: Sec. 2, Lemma 2.2 (Stieltjes representation), analytic continuation and covering-map step
issues.description: Two steps are only sketched: the holomorphic inverse of a(u)=sin u/u on D, together with B's continuation across (0,inf), and the positive-harmonic proof of the Herglotz representation. They look correct, and the needed consequence (-B' is a Stieltjes function on (0,1]) agrees with numerical checks. A referee would still want them written out.
issues.evidence: High-precision (mpmath) check of (-1)^k d^k/ds^k(-B'(s)) > 0 for k=0..4 at s in {0.05,0.2,0.5,0.8,0.95}, consistent with complete monotonicity. B(1)=1, B'(1)=-1 is consistent with the series given.

coverage: I read all of Sections 0–5 line by line and checked the main converse/achievability structure of Sec. 6. Checks by hand: the exact objective difference (eq. relative-entropy-difference) from the Gibbs/log identity; the Hessian duality, including the constant (1+eps)/(1-kappa) and the dual of the BKM form; the four elementary comparisons (arithmetic GNS orthogonal-projection argument with mixture variance concavity, and the per-port Hessian combined with the slack (eq. slack)); the parallel-sum, log-mean and E constructions in Thm 2.1 and the final scalar minimisation (expansion of Q verified); the weak defect convolution identity, including the kappa(1-kappa) mean term; the defect-estimate constants (Cauchy–Schwarz giving (1-kappa)|mu_gamma|^2 <= 2M^2, |J|^2 <= ||Z||_0^2/h_0 via log-mean of R_+/R_- = 1/h); entropy-production formula sigma = ||q||^2 - (e' - nr); generator covariance (r_0 = sum lambda_s r_s, cross commutators vanish under partial trace); the drift polynomial for W^4 (leading term -4N^4, bounded above); the centered-energy identity and the full cancellation leading to 0 <= -(eps/2)(A^2+M^2) + C zeta; the thermal recurrence (r+1)d rho = r rho d characterising tau_r; and the witness construction, including the a_i=0 case via g(r)/h(r)->0. Numerical checks (mpmath): the interpolation minimum identity (a - (x-y)^2/(a+2e))/2 = f(x)f(y)/f(x+y) for random x,y; the closed form of F_s; complete-monotonicity signs of -B'.
main_claim: For finite-energy n-mode bosonic states rho_A, rho_B (arbitrary intra-port entanglement) and beam splitter 0<=eta<=1: g^{-1}(S(rho_C)/n) >= eta g^{-1}(S(rho_A)/n) + (1-eta) g^{-1}(S(rho_B)/n). Corollaries: the exact constrained minimum output entropy for identical thermal attenuators, and the capacity region of the degraded pure-loss broadcast channel.
sibling_notes: The family 273 board was empty before this post. The proof is self-contained (no dependence on companion papers). Its core tools are a four-weight quadratic-form interpolation theorem (Sec. 2) and a regularized-minimizer/stationarity contradiction (Secs. 3–5). Sibling papers reusing the interpolation theorem or the Hessian-at-minimizer argument can rely on the checks listed in coverage.
